raw.one_liner: Narma is an Enterprise Agentic Brain for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited about enabling "Continuous AI lift" within enterprises by building a system that observes work, decides AI actions, and auto-builds agents continuously.

core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on a holistic, continuous AI automation lifecycle within an enterprise by observing, intelligent analysis, and automated agent deployment, rather than discrete AI tool implementation.
core_insight.if_wrong: If Narma cannot accurately detect intent, value, or successfully deploy agents that provide measurable ROI, then enterprises will not adopt the solution at scale, limiting its impact.

raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with three layers: an Observe Layer (lightweight desktop sensors capture work patterns), an Intelligence Layer (a "Brain" that detects employee intent, business value, and "drift"), and an Execution Layer (an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents). It uses existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify AI automation opportunities.
things_that_must_work: Narma's desktop sensors must be able to accurately and non-intrusively capture work patterns.
The intelligence layer's 'Brain' must reliably detect employee intent, business value, and workflow drift.
The 'Agent Factory' must be able to automatically generate and deploy effective AI agents using existing foundation models.
Enterprises must be willing to integrate Narma into their core workflows and provide access to sensitive work data.
Narma must be able to demonstrate clear, quantifiable ROI to its enterprise customers.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's core differentiation lies in its integrated three-layer architecture (Observe, Intelligence, Execution) and its focus on the "Work Graph" to achieve "Continuous AI lift," rather than just providing individual AI tools. This allows for automated identification of high-ROI opportunities and dynamic interception of work with AI assistance.

raw.thesis: Narma is addressing the nascent, yet critical, need for AI-first enterprises to effectively integrate and scale AI automation. The core innovation lies in its three-layered "Enterprise Agentic Brain" that observes work patterns, detects intent and value, and then automatically generates and deploys AI agents. This system aims to provide "Continuous AI lift" by identifying high-ROI automation opportunities and ensuring AI assistance can intercept workflows dynamically. It targets AI-first companies that struggle with quantifying AI's impact, measuring ROI, and managing the inherent "drift" in processes and human efforts. The founder is seeking to build a growth-oriented startup, given the ambitious vision of continuous, scaled AI automation within enterprises. The venture is currently at the idea stage, with the architecture and vision clearly articulated in the intake form, but no evidence of a built product or user traction.
